name: request_call
description: Proposes to the user that a round-table conference be convened between multiple agents on a specific topic, to compare views or brainstorm. Requires the user's explicit approval.

participants.description: List of participants (at least 2) to invite (e.g. ['@geordi', '@spock', '@worf']).

topic.description: The topic or question the conference discussion should focus on.

reason.description: A clear rationale for why a collegial discussion on this topic would be useful.
